name: worker-test-0f3493dd03/09-receive-default-before-worker-p.bal
spec_references: ## Statements: positive list includes Lock statement and Panic, but does not include named worker declarations or worker message sends.
## Expressions: positive list includes Start action, Wait action, Check expression and Trap expression, but does not include worker receive actions.
# Subset restrictions / ## Import declarations: Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported; ballerina/lang.runtime lists sleep, onGracefulStop, StopHandler.
## Invocations / ### Other invocation restrictions: Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions (list does not include future:cancel).
reason: The invoked main function requires a named worker, a default-worker send, and a worker receive, then expects a worker panic to propagate through wait. Named workers and worker message passing are absent from subset10's supported statements/actions; supported wait and panic alone do not cover that interaction. This decisive unsupported behavior makes the whole case a feature request.
unsupported_constructs: Named worker declarations and worker-to-worker/default-worker asynchronous and synchronous message passing (->, ->>, <-).
future.cancel() in retained helper functions is outside the listed langlib methods.
test_design_notes: The file retains many unrelated worker, cancellation, query, lambda and lock scenarios, although main invokes only receiveFromDefaultWithPanicBeforeReceiveInWorker.

The sole @panic marker is on the error-construction line inside the worker rather than the panic statement; its intended assertion still depends on worker panic propagation. No @args or @output markers are present.
runtime:sleep and error.message/value.toString helpers are explicitly listed as supported and are not the decisive exclusion.
